general_information.Syllabus Name: Drawing - Speed drawing _Hình họa -Vẽ tốc họa
general_information.Description: Description: Sketching is an art form that has been used for centuries, the results ranging from the quickest, loosest drawing to much more fully formed and detailed art. It continues to thrive today, being a versatile, portable technique that can be practiced not only at home or in the studio but out and about, while travelling or just gong about our daily lives. Sketching for its own sake can be a relaxing hobby, allowing the artist to practice mindfullness in a fast-paced world. It is also a medium through which we can engage with our world. observation in order to sketch is in itself rewarding, helping us to understand our place in the world and make sense of our surroundings. Sketching encourages us to take an interest in the world, and process what we find in a way that inspires us and ignites the imaginations of others. - The subject will be deployed in the studio with all requirements for learning tools for the subject. Some hours students will practice sketching outside - Speed Drawing subject helps students with Sketch knowledge and skills. This is the most radical recording method of visual arts, helping learners grasp the features, generalize and condense a vivid worldview. - Through the system from basic theory to practical exercises from basic drawing lines to create materials to sketching exercises with human body with strokes, arrays, combination lines, from sketches conceptual design to help students improve knowledge and skills.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination 2. Actively participate in class activities 3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class 4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose 5. Read the textbook in advance 6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course. 7. Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submlit to the teacher 01 day after the course.
general_information.Tools: 1. Individual tools prepared by students: - Paper (size A3, A4). Sketching papper sheet (A3) - Color, pencil, eraser, brushes, back ink pen, artlines, markers - Paper knife, roll of paper tape, - Laptop - Drawing boad. 2. Model: Recommend maximum 25 students/model. The type of model might be a live model or a composite full body statue with muscle and bone separation or other types that appropriate to the implementation condition at each campus

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the role of speed drawing in sketching, conceptual development of a design process and the uses of some of tools and materials used in drawing.
Distinguish the roles of stroke types in sketch, as well as basics shapes, perspective and scales, light and shade in sketch.
Ability to practice proficiently in all kinds of strokes and shapes in each specific sketch object with details.
Apply variety of strokes and shapes to draw people, animals, objects, plants, creatures, landscapes, transportation, food & drink, daily living scenes, and architecture.
Create drawings with complete layouts that convey the content of the story being told and make good use of knowledge and skills learned of sketch.
